# Ledger Account

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LedgerAccount`](gmeow-LedgerAccount.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LedgerAccount>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A book-keeping account in a double-entry ledger — an asset, liability, equity, revenue, or expense account. An [`InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md) distinct from [`FinancialAccount`](gmeow-FinancialAccount.md): a [`LedgerAccount`](gmeow-LedgerAccount.md) is a conceptual book-keeping construct, while a [`FinancialAccount`](gmeow-FinancialAccount.md) is a bank-level account with IBAN/BIC/number.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LedgerAccount`](gmeow-LedgerAccount.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
